According to NCERT principles for Therapeutic Approaches (Psychotherapeutic Paradigms and Mechanisms):
(A)-(III), (B)-(I), (C)-(II), (D)-(IV)

Detailed Analysis:
1. Cognitive Therapy (III): Disputing cognitive distortions and irrational beliefs.
2. Psychodynamic Therapy (I): Accessing unconscious materials via free association and dream analysis.
